tool_schemas.name: zendesk_get_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single Zendesk ticket scoped to the given workspace, addressed by either our internal ticket_id or the upstream zendesk_ticket_id, and returns the ticket record as stored in Zendesk. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id does not match the required format or if both identifiers are omitted/invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace has no configured connection or the referenced ticket cannot be located. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to access the workspace’s Zendesk connection, and RATE_LIMITED when the workspace or caller has exceeded allowed request volume.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Internal ticket row id in this integration server.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_update_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Zendesk ticket (selected by ticket_id or zendesk_ticket_id) with the provided fields and returns the updated ticket payload from Zendesk. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums/IDs, for missing ticket identifiers, or when no updatable fields are supplied; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace connection or target ticket does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when the requested change is rejected due to ticket state rules (for example, attempting an invalid status transition), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Internal ticket row id to update.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field identifier.

problem_zendesk_ticket_id.description: Zendesk ticket id of the linked problem (for incident/problem relationships).

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_create_ticket
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Zendesk ticket in the specified workspace using the supplied subject/description and optional fields (priority/type/status, assignments, tags, custom_fields, and an optional problem_zendesk_ticket_id link), and returns the created ticket payload including its Zendesk ticket id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, values don’t satisfy declared constraints (enums, minimums), or the problem_zendesk_ticket_id is not a valid positive integer. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace has no configured Zendesk connection or if a referenced entity required by the request (such as a problem ticket to link) cannot be found, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN and RATE_LIMITED for permission and quota enforcement.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field identifier.

problem_zendesk_ticket_id.description: Zendesk ticket id of the linked problem (for incident/problem relationships).

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_add_private_note
tool_schemas.description: Appends a private (internal) comment to an existing Zendesk ticket identified by ticket_id or zendesk_ticket_id and returns the updated ticket/comment result from Zendesk. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body is empty/invalid, workspace_id is malformed, or no ticket identifier is provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace connection or ticket cannot be found. Raises CONFLICT if the ticket is in a state that does not accept updates/comments, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access, and RATE_LIMITED when limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Internal ticket row id to add the note to.

zendesk_ticket_id.description: Zendesk ticket id to add the note to.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_add_public_note
tool_schemas.description: Appends a public comment to an existing Zendesk ticket identified by ticket_id or zendesk_ticket_id and returns the updated ticket/comment result from Zendesk. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body is empty/invalid, workspace_id is malformed, or no ticket identifier is provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace connection or ticket cannot be found. Raises CONFLICT if the ticket is not writable (for example, closed/deleted per Zendesk rules), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Internal ticket row id to add the comment to.

zendesk_ticket_id.description: Zendesk ticket id to add the comment to.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Zendesk ticket search within the workspace using the provided query and returns a page of matching tickets ordered by sort_by/sort_order, along with an opaque cursor when more results are available; limit controls page size (1–100). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when query is missing/invalid, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or sort parameters are not supported. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot use the workspace connection, NOT_FOUND when the workspace has no configured Zendesk connection, and RATE_LIMITED when search requests exceed allowed throughput.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_get_ticket_details
tool_schemas.description: Returns detailed information for a single Zendesk ticket (by ticket_id or zendesk_ticket_id); when include_comments is true, it also returns a page of comments up to comments_limit and a comments_cursor for pagination of additional comments. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed workspace_id, invalid/missing ticket identifiers, invalid comment paging parameters (comments_limit out of range or malformed comments_cursor), or inconsistent options. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace connection or ticket cannot be found, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient access, and RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Internal ticket row id to fetch details for.

zendesk_ticket_id.description: Zendesk ticket id to fetch details for.

include_comments.description: Whether to include ticket comments in the response.

comments_limit.description: Maximum number of comments to include when include_comments is true.

comments_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of comments.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_get_linked_incidents
tool_schemas.description: Lists incident tickets linked to the specified ticket (typically a problem ticket) and returns results in pages controlled by limit (1–100) with an opaque cursor for subsequent pages; status optionally filters links by active/removed. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed workspace_id, invalid paging parameters, unsupported status values, or when neither ticket_id nor zendesk_ticket_id is provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace connection or the anchor ticket cannot be found, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient permissions, and RATE_LIMITED when link retrieval exceeds configured quotas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

ticket_id.description: Internal ticket row id (typically the problem ticket) to find linked incidents for.

zendesk_ticket_id.description: Zendesk ticket id (typically the problem ticket) to find linked incidents for.

limit.description: Maximum number of linked incidents to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of linked incidents.

status.description: Filter linked incidents by link status.

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_search_tickets
tool_schemas.description: Searches Zendesk tickets within the given workspace using a query string and optional structured filters, and returns a paginated list of matching tickets (and optionally snippets from comments). Enforces API key/workspace quotas and a server-side hard cap on returned results (max 100 per page) regardless of requested page_size; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs and NOT_FOUND when the workspace connection is missing or inactive.

api_key.description: API key credential presented to authenticate the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace identifier to scope the Zendesk connection.

query.description: Free-text query applied to ticket subject/description/tags and (optionally) comment bodies.

include_comments.description: When true, includes comment-body matching and may return comment snippets for matches.

tags_any.description: Match tickets containing any of the provided tags.

tags_all.description: Match tickets containing all of the provided tags.

requester_id.description: Filter by Zendesk requester user id.

assignee_id.description: Filter by Zendesk assignee user id.

updated_since.description: Only return tickets with zendesk_updated_at on/after this timestamp.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (capped at 100 by the server).

tool_schemas.name: zendesk_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity resolved from the presented API key, including workspace context, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses revoked/disabled keys and disabled workspaces with NOT_FOUND or FORBIDDEN depending on policy, and raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed credentials.

api_key.description: API key credential presented to authenticate the request.

metadata.name: Zendesk Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a Zendesk Integration Server that brokers access to Zendesk tickets, comments, and incident links for multiple workspaces/accounts while enforcing auth, auditability, and rate limits.
